assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is a formal AI submission for provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Robot lane widths (2.5 m dedicated), speed tiers (5/8/10/15 km/h) and station spacing (~1.2 km) are conceptual design suggestions, not statutory traffic controls.
assumptions.impact: Traffic authority and professional planners must verify lane feasibility, speed limits and conflict design before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: Official last-mile delivery demand, origin-destination volume and pedestrian flow baselines are not published in the site package; demand estimates rely on public industry reports and are directional only.
assumptions.impact: Sizing of stations, depots and fleet scale in the proposal is illustrative; pilot demand survey is a listed precondition of JZ-01.

assumptions.statement: Industry cases (Meituan, Neolix, JD, Starship, Serve Robotics) are cited as background references; no supplier is designated as a necessary condition.
assumptions.impact: The proposal stays vendor-neutral and multi-vendor interoperable; case facts must be re-verified before any reference to them in formal deepening.

assumptions.statement: Charging depot and station sites are conceptual locations inside the provisional boundary; land ownership and use rights are unconfirmed.
assumptions.impact: Site selection must be confirmed with local streets, owners and planning authorities before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Robot operation windows and weather restrictions (rain/snow/night tiers) are proposed risk controls; final rules belong to the traffic authority and pilot approval process.
assumptions.impact: Operation rules in scenario cards are suggestions; formal operating permissions require regulatory procedures.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, building density and road redlines remain unknown because official control conditions are unpublished.
assumptions.impact: All intensity metrics keep status=unknown in metrics.json; no pseudo-precise conclusions are drawn.
